metadata.title: The ejection and detectability of high- and hyper-velocity stars by compact object binaries in globular clusters

notes: No eligible individual stars. The paper is a population-synthesis study of anonymous simulated escapers from globular clusters; it does not identify any particular star as a Galactic unbound candidate or follow up a previously identified one. Its broad HVS definition (v_GC > 500 km/s; T:p2-b6) is statistical, and it notes that only 18% of escaped stars are unbound (T:p11-b7), so aggregate model populations cannot be entered as individual stars.
